code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rbar = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 3 for x in row))
    cbar = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r == rbar or c == cbar:
                continue
            # Recursive stripe motif: progressively nested bands within each quadrant.
            rr = r if r < rbar else h-1-r
            cc = c if c < cbar else w-1-c
            out[r][c] = 4 if ((rr % 2 == 0 and cc % 2 == 0) or (rr % 4 == 1 and cc % 4 in (1,2,3))) else 0
    return out
'''
